user.title: Solar Forecast ML
user.description:
Required: panel groups with live power sensors
Optional: weather and consumption sensors

SFML calculates total power and daily yield from the panel groups automatically.

data_description.total_consumption_today: Unit: kWh. Total household electricity consumption since midnight. Must reset to 0 at midnight. (Optional)
data_description.solar_capacity: Unit: kWp (e.g. 9.6). Only needed for single systems; with panel groups this is calculated automatically. (Optional)
data_description.inverter_max_power: Unit: kW. Caps forecasts at the inverter maximum (e.g. 5.0). 0 = Disabled. (Optional)
data_description.rain_sensor: Unit: mm/h. Physical outdoor sensor required (weather station). No yes/no values, only measurements! (Optional)
data_description.lux_sensor: Unit: Lux. Physical outdoor sensor required. No indoor sensors, no simulated values! (Optional)
data_description.temp_sensor: Unit: °C. Only real measurement data from a local outdoor sensor. No online weather services! (Optional)
data_description.wind_sensor: Unit: m/s or km/h. Physical anemometer at the installation site required. (Optional)
data_description.humidity_sensor: Unit: % RH. Local outdoor sensor required. Do not use indoor values. (Optional)
data_description.pressure_sensor: Unit: hPa. Requires a physical barometer sensor on site. Used for trend detection. No online data! (Optional)
data_description.solar_radiation_sensor: Unit: W/m². Measured by on-site pyranometer. Takes priority over Lux sensors for highest precision. (Optional)

panel_groups.title: Configure Panel Groups (Required)
panel_groups.description: Set the active group count first. Only groups up to this count are saved; higher groups are ignored. Sensor is the group's live power sensor (W or kW). Azimuth: 0°=North, 90°=East, 180°=South, 270°=West. Tilt is the module angle. kWp is the installed DC capacity of the group.

data_description.panel_group_count: Choose how many panel groups should be active. To remove old groups, reduce this number.
data_description.group_1_sensor: Live power sensor for group 1. Unit must be W or kW.
data_description.group_2_sensor: Live power sensor for group 2. Leave empty if unused.
data_description.group_3_sensor: Live power sensor for group 3. Leave empty if unused.
data_description.group_4_sensor: Live power sensor for group 4. Leave empty if unused.

reconfigure_panel_groups.title: Reconfigure Panel Groups (Required)
reconfigure_panel_groups.description: Set the active group count first. Only groups up to this count are saved; higher groups are removed. Sensor is the group's live power sensor (W or kW). Azimuth: 0°=North, 90°=East, 180°=South, 270°=West. Tilt is the module angle. kWp is the installed DC capacity of the group.

data_description.panel_group_count: Choose how many panel groups should remain active. To reduce from 3 to 2 groups, set this to 2.
data_description.group_1_sensor: Live power sensor for group 1. Unit must be W or kW.
data_description.group_2_sensor: Live power sensor for group 2. Leave empty if unused.
data_description.group_3_sensor: Live power sensor for group 3. Leave empty if unused.
data_description.group_4_sensor: Live power sensor for group 4. Leave empty if unused.

error.invalid_panel_format: Invalid format. Please use: Power/Azimuth/Tilt or Power/Azimuth/Tilt/Sensor (e.g., 1200/180/30 or 1200/180/30/sensor.pv_today)
error.panel_groups_required: At least 1 panel group required. Format: Power/Azimuth/Tilt/Sensor (e.g., 5000/180/30/sensor.pv_today)
error.energy_sensor_not_found: Energy sensor not found in Home Assistant. Check the entity ID.
error.energy_sensor_not_numeric: Energy sensor value is not numeric. Check sensor state.
error.energy_sensor_not_kwh: Panel group sensor is not accepted. Use a cumulative DC energy sensor with unit kWh.
error.energy_sensor_not_dc_energy: Panel group sensor is not accepted. Expected device_class=energy.
error.energy_sensor_not_cumulative: Panel group sensor is not accepted. Expected state_class=total or total_increasing.
error.power_sensor_not_found: Power sensor not found in Home Assistant. Check the entity ID.
error.power_sensor_not_numeric: Power sensor value is not numeric. Check sensor state.
error.power_sensor_not_power_unit: Power sensor must use unit W or kW.

data_description.evcc_forecast: Provides a sensor with hourly forecast data in evcc format. Enables direct integration into evcc without template sensors. Default: OFF
data_description.notify_fog: Show notification when fog is detected
data_description.notify_frost: Show notification when frost is detected
data_description.notify_weather_alert: Show a notification when measured weather unexpectedly differs from the forecast
data_description.notify_snow_covered_panels: Show notification when panels are snow-covered
data_description.pirate_weather_api_key: Optional: Free API key from https://pirate-weather.apiable.io/ - Enables NOAA GFS/HRRR weather model for improved cloud cover blending.
data_description.adaptive_forecast_mode: When significant deviations (>35%) between morning forecast and actual production are detected, SFML automatically adjusts the afternoon forecast at 12:30. SFML autonomously decides whether a correction is beneficial - based on fresh weather data and objective criteria. Default: OFF
data_description.winter_mode: Applies an additional low-sun cloud penalty from November through February when measured or provider radiation is unavailable and SFML uses its clear-sky fallback. Default: ON
data_description.zero_export_mode: MPPT THROTTLE DETECTION: Enable if you have a zero-export regulation (e.g. Shelly). This prevents ML from learning incorrect values when your inverter throttles due to no grid export being allowed. When active and production is much lower than expected on sunny days, the hour is excluded from training.
data_description.has_battery: MPPT THROTTLE DETECTION: Enable if you have a battery storage system. When enabled, you must configure the Solar-to-Battery sensor and the Battery SOC sensor. Battery curtailment is detected only when SOC is at least 95%.
data_description.solar_to_battery_sensor: MPPT THROTTLE DETECTION: Power sensor showing energy flow from PV to battery (in Watts). Required together with the SOC sensor when battery storage is enabled. Examples: sensor.pv_to_battery_power, sensor.battery_charging_power
data_description.battery_soc_sensor: MPPT THROTTLE DETECTION: Battery state of charge in percent (0-100). Required when battery storage is enabled. Suspected battery curtailment never fires without this sensor and never fires below 95% SOC.
data_description.max_grid_export_w: Optional export or AC output limit in Watt. Default: 800 W. When zero export mode is active, SFML internally uses 0 W. This helps detect full-battery curtailment when production is capped although house load is covered.

error.battery_sensor_required: Select a Solar-to-Battery power sensor when battery storage is enabled
error.battery_soc_sensor_required: Select a battery SOC sensor when battery storage is enabled
error.energy_sensor_not_kwh: Panel group sensor must be a kWh sensor
error.energy_sensor_not_dc_energy: Panel group sensor must be an energy sensor
error.energy_sensor_not_cumulative: Panel group sensor must be cumulative
